notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Another small patch with various fixes and improvements.

Want to thank everybody who's bought and played the game so far! So cool seeing the leaderboard fill out. If you have enjoyed the game, it would be really helpful if you could leave a review- really helps the game out. Thanks to those who already have!

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Correctly disable enemy audio on death.
[*] Fix FOV slider not being visually correct on game load.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweaks to parry to be more consistent in various edge cases.
[*] Improved death animation.
[*] Enemy spawn tweaks. Also a couple new spawn locations.
[*] Rewrote flying enemy geometry avoidance- now much less prone to clipping into/through walls.
[*] Improved ragdoll behaviour.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix saved mouse sensitivity not applying on game start.
[*] Fix saved keybinds not applying on game start.
[*] Fix music sliders not being visually correct on menu open.
[*] Stop charged shot from firing after player has died.
[*] Fix pause menu button hover over sizes.
[*] Stop projectiles from spawning too many explosions on collision.
[*] Fix slide gravity when in air.
[*] Fix being able to bash whilst charging right shot.
[*] Fix camera being moved when exiting pause menu.
[*] Fix bash hitbox not rotating correctly with the player, causing bashes to sometimes hit behind you.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increase volume on charged shot ready audio cue.
[*] Decrease volume on landing sound.
[*] Reduce chance of charged shot exploding immediately when sliding on a rail.
[*] Add a minimum slide speed when sliding on a rail. You will also be reverted to a higher speed than the minimum grind speed when you exit the slide, if that speed is higher than your original grind enter speed.
[*] Remove mouse sensitivity being tied to game speed on bash hitstop.
[*] Refine bash hitbox- results in a less forgiving, but more accurate bash.
[*] Slightly reduce upwards velocity gained when jumping from a rail.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Minor post-release patch to address some issues and feedback. Thanks everybody who has bought and enjoyed the game! Love seeing the new scores appear on the leaderboards! If you have enjoyed the game please do consider leaving a review, it really helps support the game!

[h2]Patch 1.0.1:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better support for non English language usernames in leaderboards.
[*] Increase visibility during blood rain event.
[*] Add game version to main menu. 
[/list]

notes.title: Enemy Spotlight: The Spit Bat
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=9Ikdl9yg69g;full][/previewyoutube]

This enemy will follow you around, spitting acid at you, which if it doesn't kill you, will create a temporary area on the ground which will slow you down and kill your speed! Stay off the ground if you can.
